name: genieseo
description: Turn Google Search Console and GA4 data into actionable SEO insights, from quick reports to advanced cross-referencing.

interface.longDescription: GenieSEO turns Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 data into clear, actionable SEO insights. Connect your Google account to analyze clicks, impressions, CTR, rankings, landing pages, countries and devices; find keyword gaps, content decay, cannibalization and low-CTR quick wins; audit indexing and rich results; and cross-reference organic queries with GA4 conversions and revenue. All nine skills are read-only.
defaultPrompt: Give me my weekly SEO performance report.
Which of my top pages have indexing issues?
Find keyword gaps where I rank 11-50.
